Part 1 高频 抽象 ABSTRACT

Tidiness

整洁

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like to keep things tidy?

To be honest, I'm not really a tidy person. My room tends to get messy, with stuff scattered around the desk and floor, and I don't mind it much. I do tidy up before guests come over, though.

不太爱整洁，房间常常乱糟糟，桌子和地上都是东西；来客人前才收拾。

Q2Did you use to keep your room tidy as a child?

No, not at all, actually. My room was a complete mess when I was a kid, toys and books everywhere. I guess that habit never really changed, because my room is still pretty messy today.

小时候房间就很乱，玩具书本到处扔；这个习惯到现在没变。

Q3待补充

Hmm, I'd say it's important up to a point. A tidy space makes it easier to find things and feels more comfortable, but I don't think you need to be obsessive. Honestly, a bit of mess doesn't bother me.

整洁重要但不用过度；整洁好找东西更舒服，但乱一点也能接受。
